name: explorers-earth-monorepo
description: Monorepo runner for tunes and explorers-earth

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "TUNES,EXPLORERS-EARTH" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix tunes" "npm run dev --prefix explorers-earth"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix tunes && npm install --prefix explorers-earth
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix tunes && npm run build --prefix explorers-earth
